tagline.en: A world model spanning latent, JEPA, and pixel-space variants, evaluated on control tasks like PushT.
tagline.zh: 覆盖潜空间、JEPA 与像素空间多种形态的世界模型,在 PushT 等控制任务上评测。

en: LeWorldModel is a world model that predicts how an environment evolves, offered in several flavours: a latent-space world model, a JEPA-style world model, and a pixel-space world model. This lets you compare how the world is represented — abstract embeddings versus raw pixels.
WorldFoundry exposes an inference-only wrapper around the official evaluation route, following the upstream eval config flow. The published model bundle is hosted on Hugging Face.

In WorldFoundry you run the model through its evaluation entrypoint — for example on the PushT control task. Execution needs the stable-worldmodel packages, the task datasets, and policy weights (when the policy isn't random) staged first.
zh: LeWorldModel 是一个预测环境如何演变的世界模型,提供多种形态:潜空间世界模型、JEPA 风格世界模型,以及像素空间世界模型。这让你可以对比世界的不同表示方式——抽象嵌入与原始像素。
WorldFoundry 围绕官方评测路径提供了一个仅推理的封装,沿用上游的 eval 配置流程。已发布的模型包托管于 Hugging Face。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你通过评测入口运行该模型——例如在 PushT 控制任务上。执行前需先备好 stable-worldmodel 相关包、任务数据集,以及策略权重(当策略非随机时)。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want to explore world modeling across latent, JEPA, and pixel-space representations and evaluate them on control tasks such as PushT.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想在潜空间、JEPA 与像素空间等多种表示上探索世界建模,并在 PushT 等控制任务上评测时,选它。

notFor.en: It runs through an evaluation entrypoint and needs the stable-worldmodel packages, task datasets, and policy weights staged, so it's more setup than a one-shot generator.
notFor.zh: 它通过评测入口运行,需备好 stable-worldmodel 相关包、任务数据集与策略权重,因此比一键式生成器需要更多准备。
